IVX HOLDINGS — COMPLETE THE LAST CREDENTIAL BLOCKER AND RUN FINAL DEEP QA

EXECUTE THIS TASK END TO END.

The current report is not accepted as final certification because it contains a contradiction:

- Supabase Management API token: BLOCKED, HTTP 401
- Final certification: COMPLETE

Final certification cannot be COMPLETE while a required production credential is blocked.

Correct the status immediately to:

OVERALL STATUS: PARTIAL
RUNTIME DATABASE OPERATIONS: VERIFIED
SUPABASE MANAGEMENT API: BLOCKED
FINAL CERTIFICATION: NOT COMPLETE

==================================================
PHASE 1 — SUPABASE MANAGEMENT TOKEN RECOVERY
==================================================

The owner will create a new Supabase Management API token.

After the new token is placed in the approved secret location:

1. Identify the exact environment-variable name expected by the code.
2. Confirm which Render service consumes it.
3. Confirm the variable is present without displaying its value.
4. Restart or redeploy the correct Render service.
5. Make a real authenticated Supabase Management API request.
6. Confirm HTTP 200.
7. Confirm the token can access the correct Supabase project.
8. Confirm it cannot access unrelated projects.
9. Confirm no token appears in logs, API responses, source code, screenshots, or client bundles.
10. Revoke and remove all references to the old rejected token.

Do not mark this VERIFIED from variable presence alone.

Required proof:

- Environment-variable name
- Render service
- Verification timestamp
- Safe masked token fingerprint
- Supabase project reference
- Endpoint tested
- HTTP status
- Response classification
- Trace ID
- No-secret-exposure scan

==================================================
PHASE 2 — CREDENTIAL MATRIX RE-VERIFICATION
==================================================

Re-run the entire credential matrix after the token repair.

For every credential report:

- Credential category
- Environment-variable name
- Consuming service
- Runtime binding status
- Real live request performed
- HTTP result
- Permission scope
- Last verified timestamp
- Failure reason, if any

Required final categories:

- GitHub
- Render
- Supabase anonymous key
- Supabase service-role key
- Supabase Management API token
- AWS
- SMS provider
- AI gateway
- Owner identity variables
- Any email provider
- Any storage provider
- Any deployment provider

Allowed statuses:

- VERIFIED
- PARTIAL
- BLOCKED
- NOT_CONFIGURED
- NOT_USED

Final requirement:

- 0 BLOCKED credentials required for production
- 0 false VERIFIED results
- 0 secrets exposed

==================================================
PHASE 3 — FIX THE CREDENTIAL VERIFICATION ENGINE
==================================================

Audit and correct the credential-testing implementation.

The engine must not:

- Mark a credential VERIFIED because it exists
- Mark a credential PARTIAL from hardcoded assumptions
- Test the wrong endpoint
- Treat a fallback response as direct-provider success
- Expose secret values
- Reuse stale test evidence
- Report certification complete while a required credential is blocked

For every credential, perform the smallest safe real request that verifies:

- Authentication
- Correct account
- Correct project or repository
- Required permissions
- Correct production binding

Add structured fields:

- credential_id
- provider
- variable_name
- required_for_production
- runtime_present
- authentication_tested
- authorization_tested
- scope_verified
- account_verified
- resource_verified
- direct_test_result
- fallback_test_result
- verified_at
- expires_at
- error_code
- evidence_id

==================================================
PHASE 4 — DEEP STATIC AND BUILD QA
==================================================

Run all available build and static checks from a clean environment.

Required checks:

1. Clean dependency installation
2. TypeScript compilation
3. Lint
4. Unit tests
5. Integration tests
6. Expo diagnostics
7. Expo configuration validation
8. Android configuration validation
9. Android production build
10. iOS configuration validation
11. Web production build
12. Backend production build
13. Broken import scan
14. Circular dependency scan
15. Duplicate dependency scan
16. Unused dependency scan
17. Undefined environment-variable scan
18. Hardcoded-secret scan
19. Client-bundle secret exposure scan
20. Obsolete Rork dependency scan

For every command provide:

- Exact command
- Start time
- End time
- Exit code
- Relevant output
- Files affected
- Defect ID if it fails

Do not hide warnings. Classify them as blocking or non-blocking.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — DATABASE AND MIGRATION QA
==================================================

After the new Management API token is verified:

1. List the applied production migrations.
2. Compare repository migrations against production.
3. Identify missing migrations.
4. Identify migrations applied in production but absent from Git.
5. Verify migration ordering.
6. Verify rollback safety.
7. Validate RLS policies.
8. Validate indexes.
9. Validate foreign keys.
10. Validate required tables and columns.
11. Validate storage buckets and policies.
12. Confirm migrations cannot run from the client app.
13. Confirm only authorized backend or deployment services can perform schema changes.

Do not make destructive schema changes without backup and owner approval.

Required tables to verify include:

- members
- investors
- buyers
- properties
- deals
- messages
- conversations
- room_messages
- media
- documents
- transactions
- approvals
- audit_logs
- autonomous_runs
- agent_tasks
- evidence_ledger

==================================================
PHASE 6 — OWNER AUTHENTICATION DEEP QA
==================================================

Test the real production owner flow on:

- Android
- iOS
- Web

Required tests:

- Valid owner login
- Invalid password rejection
- Unknown-user rejection
- Logout
- Login after logout
- App restart persistence
- Expired-session handling
- Refresh-token rotation
- Owner-role verification
- Non-owner Admin Hub rejection
- Non-owner Variables rejection
- Direct protected-route rejection
- Owner Dashboard access
- Variables access
- Autonomous dashboard access
- Audit-log access
- Deployment-approval access

Provide screenshots, logs, timestamps, trace IDs and actual results.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — IVX OWNER AI CHAT DEEP QA
==================================================

Verify the production chat behavior:

- Opens at newest message
- No visible jump from old history
- Older messages load by cursor pagination
- Scroll position is preserved
- No duplicate messages
- Stable message ordering
- Realtime messages appear once
- Reconnect does not duplicate messages
- Keyboard does not hide the composer
- Android behavior passes
- iOS behavior passes
- Web behavior passes
- Conversation history survives restart
- Task cards open correctly
- Evidence links open correctly
- Failed tasks remain visibly failed
- Blocked tasks do not appear completed

Test with at least 1,000 mixed messages including text, images, video references and documents.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — AUTONOMOUS SYSTEM DEEP QA
==================================================

Run controlled tests across all autonomous engines.

Required scenarios:

- Successful task
- Failed task
- Retried task
- Blocked task
- Owner-approval task
- Cancelled task
- Paused task
- Restart during execution
- Restart after completion
- Duplicate job submission
- Stale worker recovery
- Evidence-generation failure

Verify:

- No duplicate execution
- No false success
- No lost task
- Every successful task has evidence
- Every failure has an exact error
- Every run has a unique trace ID
- Owner approval cannot be bypassed
- Restart preserves state
- Dashboard reflects real status

==================================================
PHASE 9 — PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT IDENTITY
==================================================

Return one clean identity block:

GITHUB OWNER:
REPOSITORY:
BRANCH:
GITHUB HEAD:
RENDER SERVICE:
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
RENDER LIVE COMMIT:
PRODUCTION /health COMMIT:
EXPO PROJECT:
ANDROID APPLICATION ID:
IOS BUNDLE ID:
API DOMAIN:
CHAT DOMAIN:
DATABASE PROJECT:
ALL COMMITS MATCH: true or false

No final verification is allowed unless the required commit values match.

==================================================
PHASE 10 — SECURITY QA
==================================================

Run and document:

- Secret scan
- Dependency vulnerability scan
- Authentication-boundary tests
- Authorization tests
- RLS tests
- Rate-limit tests
- Injection tests
- Cross-tenant access tests
- File-upload validation
- Audit-log validation
- Token-expiration tests
- Revoked-token tests
- Client-bundle inspection
- Error-response secret leakage inspection

Confirm that Supabase service-role and Management API credentials never enter the Expo client bundle.

==================================================
PHASE 11 — FINAL CERTIFICATION RULES
==================================================

The system may report FINAL CERTIFICATION: VERIFIED only when:

[ ] Supabase Management API returns authenticated success
[ ] All required credentials are VERIFIED
[ ] No required credential is BLOCKED
[ ] No secret is exposed
[ ] TypeScript passes
[ ] Lint passes or has documented non-blocking warnings only
[ ] Unit tests pass
[ ] Integration tests pass
[ ] Android production build passes
[ ] iOS configuration passes
[ ] Web production build passes
[ ] Backend production build passes
[ ] Owner authentication passes
[ ] Chat QA passes
[ ] Autonomous QA passes
[ ] Database and migrations pass
[ ] Security QA passes
[ ] GitHub HEAD matches Render live commit
[ ] /health reports the exact live commit
[ ] All evidence is new and task-specific
[ ] No blocked or failed item is hidden

Until all requirements pass, report:

FINAL CERTIFICATION: NOT COMPLETE

==================================================
FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT
==================================================

Return exactly:

1. DIRECT RESULT
2. SUPABASE MANAGEMENT TOKEN RESULT
3. COMPLETE CREDENTIAL MATRIX
4. CREDENTIAL ENGINE FIXES
5. BUILD AND STATIC QA
6. DATABASE AND MIGRATION QA
7. OWNER AUTHENTICATION QA
8. CHAT QA
9. AUTONOMOUS QA
10. ANDROID QA
11. IOS QA
12. WEB QA
13. SECURITY QA
14. PRODUCTION IDENTITY PROOF
15. DEFECTS FOUND
16. DEFECTS FIXED
17. BLOCKED ITEMS
18. UNVERIFIED ITEMS
19. FINAL ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST
20. FINAL CERTIFICATION STATUS

Do not return another broad narrative.
Do not claim certification complete while any required item is blocked.
Do not reuse evidence from older tasks.
Do not display or log any credential value.
